capabilities: Search notes semantically in Chinese via a local hybrid retrieval service
Show result cards with title, path, highlighted snippet, source badge, and fused score
Open the matching note from a search result
Configure service URL, result count, and directory filters
Check retrieval service health and index status
extras: Desktop only (mobile cannot reach 127.0.0.1). The plugin ships no embedding model and does no indexing; without the separately run service the panel opens but returns no results. Installable manually or via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search is keyword-based and handles Chinese semantic matching poorly, with no way to fuse vector and full-text retrieval.

requires.name: local Python HTTP retrieval service on 127.0.0.1:8765

summary: Chinese semantic search panel that queries a self-hosted local hybrid retrieval service (vector + FTS5 fused via RRF) and jumps to matching notes.
